name: Intermountain Health
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of Real Salt Lake since the 2025 home kit (its insurance arm Select Health carried the front in 2024). Intermountain Health is a non-profit health system; proposed tier 'none' (nothing found beyond ordinary US healthcare-sector conduct). For the maintainer: The National Trial Lawyers reports that a Utah jury returned a USD 1.6m wrongful-death and medical-malpractice verdict against Intermountain Healthcare for fatally overdosing a patient with prescribed medications (Krambule v. Intermountain Healthcare, Second District Court, Ogden, Utah; death 2008, suit filed 2010, thenationaltriallawyers.org/article/patient-overdose) — whether an ordinary-course malpractice verdict counts as a company record under METHOD.md is a maintainer call.
